{{Top}}
'''Rogue Six''' was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] used by certain [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]].

The pilots who used the call sign included:
*[[Ardana Cinn]] ([[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]])<ref name="SW15">[[Star Wars (2013) 15|''Star Wars'' (2013) 15]]</ref>
*[[Samoc Farr/Legends|Samoc Farr]] ([[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]])<ref name="Essential Guide to Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
*[[Wes Janson/Legends|Wes Janson]] (3.5 ABY)<ref name="SOTE">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref>
*[[Derek Klivian/Legends|Derek Klivian]] ([[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]])<ref name="XWRS:MR">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 35|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 35]]</ref>
*[[Nawara Ven]] ([[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]])<ref name="XW:TKT">''[[X-Wing: The Krytos Trap]]''</ref>
*[[Gavin Darklighter]] (7&ndash;[[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]])<ref name="XW:SC">''[[X-Wing: Solo Command]]''</ref><ref name="XW:IR">''[[X-Wing: Isard's Revenge]]''</ref>
